skill.procedure:
def apply(inputs, premises):
    lengths = inputs["bag_lengths"]
    widths = inputs["bag_widths"]
    heights = inputs["bag_heights"]
    weights = inputs["bag_weights"]
    carry_limits = premises["carryon_max_dimensions"]
    carry_index = -1
    for i in range(len(lengths)):
        if carry_index == -1 and float(lengths[i]) <= float(carry_limits[0]) and float(widths[i]) <= float(carry_limits[1]) and float(heights[i]) <= float(carry_limits[2]):
            carry_index = i
    base_fees = premises["base_checked_fees_after_complimentary_rules"]
    standard_weights = premises["standard_weight_by_checked_ordinal"]
    weight_bounds = premises["weight_upper_bounds"]
    weight_fees = premises["weight_fees"]
    standard_size = float(premises["standard_size"])
    size_bounds = premises["size_upper_bounds"]
    size_fees = premises["size_fees"]
    checked_ordinal = 0
    total_fees = 0
    for i in range(len(lengths)):
        if i != carry_index:
            position = min(checked_ordinal, len(base_fees) - 1)
            weight_position = min(checked_ordinal, len(standard_weights) - 1)
            base_fee = float(base_fees[position])
            weight = float(weights[i])
            standard_weight = float(standard_weights[weight_position])
            weight_fee = 0
            weight_band_found = False
            for j in range(len(weight_bounds)):
                if not weight_band_found and weight > standard_weight and weight <= float(weight_bounds[j]):
                    weight_fee = float(weight_fees[j])
                    weight_band_found = True
            total_size = float(lengths[i]) + float(widths[i]) + float(heights[i])
            size_fee = 0
            size_band_found = False
            for j in range(len(size_bounds)):
                if not size_band_found and total_size > standard_size and total_size <= float(size_bounds[j]):
                    size_fee = float(size_fees[j])
                    size_band_found = True
            total_fees = total_fees + base_fee + max(weight_fee, size_fee)
            checked_ordinal = checked_ordinal + 1
    return {"answer": int(float(inputs["ticket_price"]) + total_fees)}
